holdings by 226.4K SOL (2.7%), to 8.73M SOL as of November 9, representing nearly 1.5% of circulating supply.
The company acquired the additional SOL at an average cost of $75 per token.
SOL holdings per fully diluted share increased 2.3% to 0.0824 during the first 40 days of fiscal 2027.
The company secured a $50M credit facility from an FDIC-insured bank at an interest rate of SOFR + 150 basis points, with a two-year term, to support its SOL accumulation strategy.
The company also committed up to $50M to USHP, a tokenized product tracking U.S. home prices, as part of its strategy to generate additional income for SOL purchases.
